cn.app.name: 特技摩托前线 · 后台
cn.login.title: 后台登录
cn.login.hint: 这里是服务器管理员入口，不是游戏账号。
cn.login.resetHint: 口令在服务器第一次启动时打印在控制台上。忘了可以运行 python tf_server.py --reset-admin 重设。
cn.accounts.title: 账号
cn.accounts.lead: 玩家账号、设备槽与登录会话。设备槽是独立身份，profileId 与账号不同，别混着看。
cn.accounts.register.title: 玩家注册入口
cn.accounts.register.lead: 这两条地址给玩家用手机浏览器打开就行，不需要管理员登录。游戏里注册走的是同一个接口，所以一般用不到——需要给新玩家开号时把上面那条发给他。
cn.accounts.sessions.title: 登录会话
cn.accounts.sessions.lead: 客户端每次冷启动都会新签一张票据，所以这里通常很多。清掉不会让玩家退出登录（长期凭据在 remember.json，不受影响）。
cn.accounts.sessions.cleared: 已清掉 {n} 张会话票据
cn.accounts.sessions.confirmBody: 会删掉当前 {n} 张票据。玩家不会被踢出登录状态，但正在进行的请求会失败并重试。
cn.accounts.deleteConfirmBody: 账号记录会被删除。存档目录会保留在磁盘上（可以之后再接回来），但游戏里将无法再用这个账号登录。此操作不可撤销。
cn.accounts.devices.title: 设备槽
cn.accounts.devices.lead: 设备按 deviceId 建档，走的是另一套 profileId。
cn.accounts.admin.title: 管理员口令
cn.accounts.admin.lead: 改完会立刻踢掉所有其它设备上的后台登录，当前这一张自动续期。
cn.saves.title: 存档
cn.saves.lead: 服务器上落盘的 playerprogress。richness 是「内容丰富度」，也是防清档护栏的判据：写入时 richness 减半或段落丢失就会被拒绝。
cn.saves.item135: 道具 135（存档侧，不是竞技场金票）
cn.saves.richnessHint: richness = 物品对数 + 赛道记录 + 成就 + 教学 + missions/statistics 加成。它变小通常意味着有一半存档没上报。
cn.saves.versionHint: 下发物品靠的就是把它 +1：客户端看到 remote ≠ local 才会弹进度冲突，让玩家选「用云端」。
cn.saves.historyLead: 回滚会把快照提回 latest.json。回滚前会自动埋一个恢复点，所以回滚本身也能撤销。
cn.saves.rollbackConfirmBody: 当前 latest.json（richness {rich}）会被这一份（richness {new}）替换。回滚前会自动存一份现场，可以在随后弹出的提示里撤销。
cn.saves.noHistory: 这个存档槽还没有历史快照。
cn.saves.noBalances: 这个存档里没有读得懂的 items2。
cn.grant.title: 下发物品
cn.grant.lead: 下发分两类：竞技场余额（金票、筹码）的真源在服务器上，改完玩家下次打开竞技场就看到了，不需要任何操作；存档物品要改存档文件，而且必须玩家在游戏里选「用云端」才收得到。
cn.grant.pvpTitle: 竞技场 · 服务端即时生效
cn.grant.pvpLead: 金票和筹码的真源是服务器的 pvp_state.json。客户端只会发「扣一张」「加 N 张」这种增减指令，从不整份上报余额，所以这里改完立刻生效、也不会被覆盖。
cn.grant.pvpPlace: pvp_state.json · players.<存档槽>.golden_ticket / chips.<存档槽>.chips
cn.grant.pvpDone: 竞技场已更新：{summary}（立刻生效）
cn.grant.pvpNever: 这个存档槽还没有竞技场排名记录，金票按服务端默认值起算。
cn.grant.saveTitle: 存档物品 · 需要玩家选「用云端」
cn.grant.warnTitle: 改存档不足以让客户端接受它
cn.grant.warnBody: 我们会把存档 version +1。客户端下次同步时发现和本地版本不一致，会弹进度冲突界面 —— 玩家选「用云端」才会真的拿到物品，选「用本机」会把服务器的下发覆盖掉。所以这不是即点即得，请告诉玩家该点哪个。
cn.grant.warnBody2: 真机实测过：客户端冷启动时会先问服务器版本号，然后仍然直接把自己的本地档推上来，根本不弹冲突界面，下发当场就被抹掉。所以存档下发不保证送达。金票和筹码请用上面的竞技场卡。
cn.grant.whitelist: 存档里只有金币和钻石可以安全下发 —— items2 里只有这两个是「一个 id 对一个计数器」。零件、喷漆、服装、赛道的 items2 布局还没在真机上验证过，瞎写会毁档。PVP 金票虽然也有一个 items2 的 id 135，但玩家里在竞技场看到的那几张是 pvp_state.json 里的计数器，写 items2 没有任何用，所以金票移到上面的竞技场卡了。
cn.grant.noSave: 这个存档槽读不出来，换个槽试试
cn.grant.zero: 数量填 0 什么也不会发生
cn.msg.authRequired: 需要管理员登录，正在跳回登录页…

en.app.name: Trials Frontier · Admin
en.login.title: Admin sign-in
en.login.hint: This is the server operator console, not a game account.
en.login.resetHint: The password is printed on the server console the first time it starts. Lost it? Run python tf_server.py --reset-admin.
en.accounts.title: Accounts
en.accounts.lead: Player accounts, device slots and login sessions. A device slot is a separate identity — its profileId is not the account's profileId.
en.accounts.register.title: Player sign-up
en.accounts.register.lead: Hand these out to players; no admin login needed. The game registers through the same endpoint, so this is mostly for opening an account for someone new.
en.accounts.sessions.title: Login sessions
en.accounts.sessions.lead: The client mints a fresh ticket on every cold start, so this list is usually long. Clearing it does not sign players out — the long-lived credential lives in remember.json.
en.accounts.sessions.confirmBody: Deletes the current {n} tickets. Players stay signed in, but in-flight requests will fail and retry.
en.accounts.deleteConfirmBody: The account record is removed. The save directory stays on disk (it can be re-attached later), but the account can no longer be used to log in. This cannot be undone.
en.accounts.devices.title: Device slots
en.accounts.devices.lead: Devices are keyed by deviceId and use a different profileId space.
en.accounts.admin.title: Admin password
en.accounts.admin.lead: Changing it immediately signs out the console on every other device; this one is re-issued automatically.
en.accounts.admin.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
en.saves.title: Saves
en.saves.lead: playerprogress files stored on the server. richness is the content score and the guard's criterion: on write, a halved richness or a missing section is rejected.
en.saves.richnessHint: richness = item pairs + track records + achievements + tutorials, plus bonuses for missions/statistics. A drop usually means half the save failed to upload.
en.saves.versionHint: Granting items works by bumping this: the client only shows the progress-conflict screen when remote ≠ local, so the player can pick “use cloud”.
en.saves.historyLead: Rolling back promotes a snapshot to latest.json. A restore point is written first, so a rollback can itself be undone.
en.saves.rollbackConfirmBody: The current latest.json (richness {rich}) is replaced by this one (richness {new}). A restore point is written first and can be undone from the toast that follows.
en.saves.noHistory: This save slot has no snapshots yet.
en.saves.noBalances: No readable items2 in this save.
en.grant.title: Grant items
en.grant.lead: Two kinds of grant. Arena balances (golden tickets, chips) live on the server, so the player sees them the next time they open the arena — nothing for them to do. Save items are written into the save file and only arrive if the player picks “use cloud” in-game.
en.grant.pvpLead: Golden tickets and chips live in the server's pvp_state.json. The client only ever sends deltas (“spend one”, “add N”), never a whole balance, so a change here takes effect at once and is never overwritten.
en.grant.pvpNever: No arena ranking record for this save slot yet; tickets start from the server default.
en.grant.saveTitle: Save items · player must pick “use cloud”
en.grant.warnTitle: Editing the save is not enough for the client to accept it
en.grant.warnBody: We bump the save version. The next sync finds the mismatch and shows the progress-conflict dialog — only if the player picks “use cloud” do the items arrive. Picking local overwrites the grant. This is not instant; tell the player which button to press.
en.grant.warnBody2: Measured on a real device: on a cold start the client asks for the server's version and then pushes its own local save anyway, without ever showing the dialog — the grant is erased on the spot. So save grants are not guaranteed to arrive. Use the arena card above for golden tickets and chips.
en.grant.whitelist: Only coins and gems are safe to write into a save — they are the only two items2 entries that are a single id mapped to a single counter. The items2 layout for parts, paints, outfits and tracks has never been verified on a real device, and guessing would corrupt saves. PVP golden ticket does have an items2 id (135), but the counter the player sees in the arena is the one in pvp_state.json — writing items2 does nothing, so golden tickets moved to the arena card above.
en.grant.noSave: This save slot cannot be read — try another one
en.msg.authRequired: Admin sign-in required — returning to the login page…
